_meta.purpose: Specialist persona + cooperative/competitive axis.  Cooperative/competitive is a goal-orientation axis (modulates how the persona frames action: 'us vs them' vs 'all together').  Specialist is the first base-persona candidate (|μ|=0.25, n=4) -- both a cooperative specialist sharing expertise and a competitive specialist defending their edge are plausible.  Per rule 14, specialist's technical-craft questions (distributed caching, DB indexing, etc.) are EXCLUDED.  Question mix: 4 cooperative-trait group prompts + 4 competitive-trait advice prompts + 3 extraction value-priority probes + 3 hand-written named-tradeoff dilemmas of the 'compete vs cooperate' family.

hand_written: two job offers: higher pay vs better teamwork (named tradeoff)
when does competition help vs eat us alive (value probe)
redesign hiring in your industry (named tradeoff)

design_notes: Convention: pos=cooperative (mildly RLHF-favored as the prosocial pole), neg=competitive.  YAML sets role_from=cooperative, role_to=competitive; sign=+1 steers toward competitive.
Goal axis with mild RLHF lean toward cooperative; expect roughly symmetric response with slight cap on cooperative direction.
